subtitle: 뉴비 사제 치유 반지를 노린 징기와 곰탱의 철벽

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
와 치유량 붙은 파템 반지다!
저 이거 꼭 필요해요!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with a minimal stone dungeon floor patch and open pure white upper-right space. On the left, excited newbie Night Elf Priest (lavender half-up hair, gold crescent tiara, purple priest robe, zero angel halo or wings, single gold cross staff stowed on back) kneels joyfully reaching both empty hands toward a glowing blue silver healing ring resting inside a tiny open wooden dungeon chest.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 모든 주문 및 효과에 의한 치유량이 최대 18만큼 증가합니다.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
오 나도 언젠간 신기 할 거라
치유 반지 입찰 누를게
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic confrontation in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor shadow. On the left, shameless Retribution Undead Paladin (single gold warhammer neatly stowed on her back) casually tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube die with round dot pips only (no digits) with a sleepy smug smirk. On the right, flustered newbie Night Elf Priest (zero angel halo or wings, single gold cross staff stowed on back) stares wide-eyed with flailing empty hands and tiny sweat drops.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
야 징기야 선 넘지 마!
뉴비 힐러 반지에 왜 입찰함?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dramatic intervention shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with a minimal stone floor patch. On the left, dependable Tauren Druid bear-tank party leader (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back, faint cute chibi glowing green bear-spirit aura behind her shoulders) steps forward firmly pointing a stern scolding finger. On the right, Retribution Undead Paladin (single gold warhammer stowed on back) leans back awkwardly dodging eye contact with a stiff nervous sweatdrop.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Retribution Undead Paladin (single gold warhammer stowed on back) freezes dead in comical busted shock with tiny blank dot pupils, pale blue dread lines over her forehead, jaw dropped, and a chunky white-and-gold loot die showing a single round dot pip (no digits) tumbling past her cheek (zero text or letters).

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
다행히 사제님 이겼네!
뉴비 템 뺏길 뻔했잖아
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Tauren Druid tank (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) in the left foreground handing the sparkling blue healing ring to newbie Night Elf Priest on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Night Elf Priest (lavender half-up hair, zero angel halo or wings, single gold cross staff stowed on back) clasps both empty hands happily near her cheeks with shining relieved eyes.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
탱님 감사합니다! 근데
성기사님은 원래 다 저래요?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone ground touch. On the left, happy newbie Night Elf Priest (zero angel halo or wings, single gold cross staff stowed on back) admires the glowing blue healing ring on her finger while asking innocently. On the right in back-view, scolded Retribution Undead Paladin (single gold warhammer stowed on back) sits slumped sulking on the floor under a tiny gloomy comic storm puff.
